jobs.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Team**  
  
Earners (drivers and couriers) are an integral part of Uber’s multi-sided marketplace. They provide the time and the means to move people and things. Importantly, they enable the connection between the physical and digital world to make the movement happen at the push of a button for everyone, everywhere.  
  
Within Uber, the Earner Intelligence team plays a critical role in earners’ journey as the team is responsible for building AI/ML systems across earner onboarding, activation, early life cycle, and resurrection.  
  
The team employs a variety of ML/AI techniques, spanning from causal ML meta learners, supervised ML, RL multi-armed bandits and contextual bandits, genAI LLM, long running agents, agentic harnesses, and training our own Earner language model to deep learning embeddings to build impactful data products  
  
**What the candidate will do**  

* Design, build, and ship Earner facing agentic experiences by building conversational and ambient (long running) agents
* Build statistical, optimization, and machine learning models
* Work closely with multi-functional leads to develop technical vision, new methodological approaches, and drive team direction.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as product, engineering, operations, and marketing to drive ML system development end-to-end from conceptualization to final product.

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or other related quantitative fields or related field
* 4 years minimum of industry experience as a Machine Learning Engineer/Research Scientist with a strong focus on agentic AI and reinforcement learning building conversational and ambient (long running) agents, designing short and long-term memory (knowledge graph, semantic search), Reinforcement learning (Proximal Policy Optimization, Direct Preference Optimization)
* Proficiency in multiple object-oriented programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Java, C++).
* Experience with any of the following: Spark, Hive, Kafka, Cassandra.
* Experience building and productionizing innovative end-to-end Machine Learning systems.
* Experience in exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams(product, science, product ops etc).

  
Preferred Qualifications  

* PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or other related quantitative fields or related field
* 5+ years of industry experience in machine learning, including building and deploying computer vision models and architectures.
* Expertise on expertise with post training, Knowledge Distillation, Fine tuning such as SFT, LoRa.
* Publications at industry recognized ML conferences.
* Expertise in the design and architecture of ML systems and workflows.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For Seattle, WA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Biotech
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a biotech AI engineering team building and operating data infrastructure that turns clinical, genomic, imaging, and other biomedical data into reliable assets for machine learning. This hands-on role supports data workflows from ingestion and analysis through model training and deployment to partner environments.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain cloud data platform components, including object storage, lakehouse architecture, catalogs, lineage, versioning, and access systems.
* Design and operate governed data stores and releases for clinical records, molecular features, metadata, and linked datasets.
* Develop reproducible bioinformatics pipelines for omics data, using containerized workflows and cloud batch compute.
* Implement data quality checks, biological validation, and visualizations that help teams identify issues.
* Prepare versioned, training-ready datasets and build data deployment interfaces for partner environments.
* Operate production infrastructure, including Kubernetes, CI/CD, distributed workload scheduling, security, observability, reliability, and cost optimization.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Two to five years building data infrastructure and production pipelines in biotech, diagnostics, biobanking, health data, or a related setting involving sensitive biological or clinical data.
* Production experience operating Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar tools, and shipping tested Python and/or Go code.
* Experience designing CI/CD and deployment systems, job orchestration, and infrastructure for machine learning workloads; GPU or distributed training experience is valuable.
* Familiarity with a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, plus workflow managers such as Nextflow, lakehouse and warehouse design, data catalogs, and orchestration.
* Experience with large-scale data pipelines, bioinformatics or omics data such as WGS, RNA-seq, or proteomics; familiarity with OMOP, FHIR, R, or SQL is helpful.
* Understanding of compliance controls such as HIPAA, GDPR, or SOC 2, and strong engineering practices for testing, documentation, code review, and provenance.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $180,000 to $240,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

Hybrid role based in San Francisco, California. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco.

Compensation Range: $180K - $240K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**

Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road.

Every day, Gatik's autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high-frequency freight operations.

Gatik's momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business.

And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list.

There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here.

**About the Team**

Scaling our machine learning models with data and fast infrastructure is central to how Gatik's autonomy stack keeps improving. The Scalable ML team builds the data generation, curation, orchestration, and distributed training infrastructure that lets our ML developers work efficiently with large volumes of real-world fleet data and simulated driving scenarios. The team sits at the intersection of ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and High Performance Computing, and partners closely with Gatik's autonomy, simulation, safety, and data teams.

**About the Role**

As a Senior or Staff engineer on Scalable ML, you'll design and build the systems that turn raw driving data from Gatik's fleet into high-quality training and evaluation sets, run training and evaluation reliably at scale, and give engineers the metrics and tools they need to make confident release decisions for driverless operations. At the Staff level, you'll also set multi-quarter technical direction and act as a technical bridge across teams that don't report to you.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build scalable data pipelines.** Design and maintain reproducible pipelines that discover, label, and organize driving scenarios from Gatik's fleet and simulation, with versioning, provenance, well-designed train/validation/holdout splits, and clear data contracts.
* **Curate high-quality datasets.** Build balanced training and evaluation sets that cover the scenarios our trucks encounter across routes, weather, and traffic conditions, and analyze coverage, composition, and label quality to shape dataset and model priorities.
* **Scale training and evaluation infrastructure.** Build distributed training, inference, and evaluation pipelines with robust data loading, checkpointing, and experiment tracking that run smoothly on multi-tenant GPU clusters.
* **Drive MLOps best practices.** Implement model artifact management, experiment tracking, and automated model testing and deployment at a standard other teams across Gatik adopt.
* **Own the metrics.** Define, implement, and validate model and release metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC, calibration, and task-specific metrics) with the statistical rigor that safety-critical release decisions demand, and characterize how behavior evolves across software releases and scenario types.
* **Run thoughtful experiments.** Set up baselines, ablations, and holdout comparisons; quantify uncertainty; and communicate results that help the autonomy team decide with confidence.
* **Build tools engineers love.** Develop dashboards and services for comparing software versions, exploring results at the scenario level, visualizing model outputs, and gathering reviewer feedback.
* **Shape shared infrastructure.** Partner with ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and HPC engineers to design and review changes to GPU scheduling and quota, job orchestration, storage, and compute cost.
* **Raise the engineering and reliability bar.** Design clean interfaces between data, modeling, and product layers; champion testing, type checking, code review, and fast CI; and lead root-causing and prevention of incidents, including those that cross team boundaries.
* **Lead technically (Staff).** Define and drive multi-quarter technical strategy for data and training infrastructure, represent Scalable ML in architecture discussions, and mentor engineers across the team.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant industry experience (or a Master's degree and 3+ years). Staff candidates typically bring 8+ years, including time setting technical direction beyond a single team.
* Strong Python software engineering skills, including designing modular, maintainable, high-performance, well-tested systems in a shared codebase.
* Experience building end-to-end ML systems, from data pipelines and dataset curation through training, evaluation, and production, using tools such as SQL, pandas, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
* Hands-on production experience with Ray (Ray Core, Ray Data, Ray Train, and/or Ray Tune), including running and debugging Ray workloads at scale.
* Deep experience with PyTorch and PyTorch

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend Platforms and Agentic & ML Systems
jobs.description:
**Why Socure?**
---------------

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a **Software Engineer – Backend Platforms and Agentic & ML Systems** to help build the backend, artificial intelligence, and machine-learning foundations that power Socure’s agentic investigation systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to work across backend services, distributed systems, AI agents, retrieval, machine-learning models, and production infrastructure. You will design, implement, test, and operate software that supports agent orchestration, asynchronous workflows, knowledge retrieval, model integration, evaluation, and reliable production operation.

You will contribute to systems supporting multi-step investigations across use cases such as watchlist review, sanctions and PEP matching, adverse-media analysis, fraud-ring correlation, case management, and other risk and compliance workflows.

A key part of the role is helping agents work with accurate, relevant, and timely domain knowledge. You will build capabilities that dynamically provide contextual information to agents, combine structured and unstructured data, support knowledge-graph and retrieval workflows, and preserve evidence and provenance for downstream decisions.

You will work with experienced engineers, machine-learning practitioners, product partners, and investigation experts to turn complex problems into dependable software. The role is calibrated for an engineer who can own well-scoped features and components, learn quickly, contribute to design discussions, and grow toward broader technical ownership.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, test, and operate backend services that support agent orchestration, task execution, state management, model integrations, and investigation workflows.
* Build synchronous and asynchronous workflows for agent tasks, including queues, retries, resumability, cancellation, idempotency, scheduling, and failure recovery.
* Contribute to agent frameworks and developer harnesses that support tool calling, structured outputs, reusable skills, actor-based workflows, human review, and policy-controlled execution.
* Implement services that dynamically inject relevant knowledge into agent workflows based on investigation type, entity context, workflow state, customer policy, prior findings, and current task requirements.
* Build domain-grounding capabilities that help agents distinguish authoritative facts, customer-defined policies, derived signals, hypotheses, and unverified observations.
* Develop knowledge-ingestion and enrichment pipelines that normalize, classify, chunk, index, version, and refresh structured and unstructured data.
* Implement retrieval workflows using combinations of semantic search, lexical search, metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, reranking, entity-aware retrieval, and temporal filtering.

jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows.  
  
The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, cross-team collaboration, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build scalable data infrastructure:** Design and evolve shared feature stores and distributed processing pipelines that support model training, inference, backtesting, simulation, and planning.
* **Make data trustworthy:** Develop automated validation, monitoring, and alerting to detect freshness, completeness, and correctness issues before they affect downstream consumers.
* **Improve data lifecycle operations:** Build efficient capabilities for incremental processing, historical backfills, schema evolution, data versioning, and recovery from failed or incorrect writes.
* **Enable self-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support.
* **Optimize performance and cost:** Identify bottlenecks in data processing, storage, and orchestration, and improve throughput, resource efficiency, and reliability.
* **Drive technical projects end to end:** Translate ambiguous requirements into designs, lead implementation and rollout, and own production health through on-call, incident response, and long-term improvements.
* **Collaborate and mentor:** Partner with modeling, financial-data, and shared-platform teams to establish consistent data foundations; guide engineers through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or a related technical role.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, Go, or a comparable language.
* Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale data pipelines or distributed data-processing systems.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, storage systems, and query-performance optimization.
* Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations.
* Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering and data science teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with Apache Spark or comparable distributed data-processing frameworks.
* Experience with Apache Hudi or similar data lake technologies supporting incremental updates, schema evolution, and versioned datasets.
* Experience building feature stores or data infrastructure for machine learning, forecasting, optimization, or simulation.
* Experience developing reusable data-quality frameworks, observability systems, or tools for tracing and reconciling data across sources.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and distributed computing frameworks such as Ray.
* Experience building self-service platforms or automation that reduces operational overhead for engineers and scientists.
* A track record of measurable improvements in data reliability, processing performance, infrastructure cost, or developer productivity.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**

jobs.title: E11 Bio - Machine Learning Scientist I/II
jobs.description:
E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight-knit start-up. Read our technology roadmap.

We are seeking a creative and mission-driven Machine Learning Scientist to develop scalable automatic proofreading methods leveraging barcode and shape information. In this role, you will own core ML pipelines for automated proofreading of neuron and synaptic reconstructions in optical connectomics datasets, working closely with wet lab scientists, microscopists, and domain experts to ensure biological fidelity and scalability. Your work will directly support E11’s goal of making reliable connectomic data accessible to the broader neuroscience community.

In this role you will be focused on decreasing segmentation and proofreading costs for optical connectomics datasets that we are generating at E11, a critical bottleneck in the connectomics field. You will be responsible for improving initial segmentations using large spatial contexts with rich data features, and ingesting resulting datasets into scalable proofreading software for dissemination to the scientific community.

### **Responsibilities**

* Contribute to developing innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of segmentations in large PB-scale optical connectomics volumes, leveraging shape and barcode information
* Own the deployment of scalable workflows to ingest large connectomic datasets into standard proofreading software (WebKnossos, CAVE)
* Collaborate with academic and industry experts on building and extending tools for automated proofreading and interactive visualization
* Develop, implement, and evaluate scalable pipelines for synapse detection and partner assignment in large-scale optical connectomics datasets, integrating morphological and protein labeling information

* Identify and build ML-based image processing tools that remove key bottlenecks in our data processing and analysis pipeline
* Maintain excellent laboratory science practices, communicate results through reports and presentations, and contribute to and assist in preparation of manuscripts, abstracts and other scientific documents.

### **Required qualifications**

* Ph.D. in computer science, machine learning, applied math, computational biology or a related field in science and/or engineering or Ph.D.-equivalent publication history
* 3-5 years of relevant work or research experience, with strong history of independent and autonomous execution of novel ML solutions
* Strong background in computer vision and applying ML tools to the analysis of large microscopy data sets
* Experience with software engineering best practices (e.g. version control, code reviews, etc)
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, record keeping ability, and attention to detail

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with graph, sequence, or point based ML methods (GNNs, Transformers, Pointnets, etc.)
* Experience with processing large chunked data (e.g Zarr) in the cloud (e.g. AWS or GCP)
* Experience with large scale connectomics data and tools (e.g. Neuroglancer, WebKnossos, CAVE, CATMAID, etc.)
* Strong record of publications in peer reviewed scientific journals a plus.

### **In the first six months, you will:**

* Become familiar with our existing ML and distributed processing code bases
* Own the processing (segmentations) of a new dataset end-to-end and identify areas for improvement (accuracy and efficiency)
* Integrate internal graph-based methods for automatic proofreading into standard block-wise workflows for PB-scale optical connectomics volumes

* Optimize ingestion of smaller segmentation graphs into standard proofreading software (e.g WebKnossos, CAVE) for improving efficiency of ground truth generation

### **In 12 months, you will:**

* Develop novel innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of neuron segmentations, leveraging both shape and barcode information
* Contribute to algorithmic development across the segmentation pipelines increasing computational throughput
* Contribute to achieving cubic-mm scale reconstruction at 100x lower proofreading costs
* Scale ingestion of PB-sized optical volumes into proofreading software and pilot proofreading and dissemination of large connectomic subgraphs

### **You would love this job if…**

* You are passionate about moonshot neuroscience, and want to broadly accelerate science through long-term commitment to a high-impact project with a tight-knit team
* You have a strong desire and intrinsic motivation to work collaboratively and inclusively as part of an interdisciplinary team science effort
* You are committed to the ethos of open science, and want to see your work transparently disseminated
* You’re mission-driven, and are seeking an environment where you can take long-term risks on moonshot science, shielded from academic or for-profit incentives
* You’re seeking a high-leverage, non-traditional opportunity to maximize the impact of your science, establishing relationships with key stakeholders in the neuroscience community

### **We Offer**

* An opportunity to help change the world and work with a world-class interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers on a field-defining moonshot
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan; parental leave.
* Generous time off + paid holidays.
* 401K matching up to 6% of base salary
* Ample healthy and energizing food including daily lunches.
* Stipend for fitness and wellness activities.

Base Salary Range: $130,000 - $225,000

Bonus: Performance-based, up to 20% of base salary

401k match: up to 6%

jobs.description:
### **About Anyware Robotics**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

### **Description**

About Anyware

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

The Role

The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a **Sr. AI Perception Engineer** to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.

This role is for an engineer who builds AI perception that works on real sensor data and physical systems — not only on benchmarks — and who wants to take it through production and real-world operation. You will own perception capabilities end to end within your area — problem definition, model and pipeline development, deployment on robot hardware, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement — and make pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will own the design decisions in your area, contribute to architecture and design reviews, and work closely with the Perception Team Lead and Staff engineers who set technical direction across the perception stack.

What you'll do

* **Build 3D AI perception on physical systems, hands-on** — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction models and pipelines using RGB-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.
* **Own perception capabilities end to end** — from problem definition and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement within Anyware's existing perception stack.
* **Improve perception reliability on physical robots** — diagnose and fix failures caused by difficult scenes, changing lighting, sensor noise, and gaps between training data and customer environments.
* **Strengthen production readiness** — better data, evaluation, regression testing, release criteria, observability, and systematic root-cause analysis of field failures.
* **Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system** — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software.

Required Skills

* BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **3+** years of professional experience developing **AI perception systems** for physical robots or comparable real-world machines.
* **Hands-on proficiency building AI perception models** (PyTorch or similar) and real-time perception pipelines in Python and C++.

Nice to have

* Experience deploying and operating AI perception in production on physical robots — running models under latency and compute constraints on robot hardware and owning reliability in the field.
* Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB-D or point-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation.
* Experience with ROS or ROS2 for real-time robotic perception pipelines, including sensor-data processing and model integration.
* Experience deploying robotic perception systems in warehouse, logistics, or other industrial environments.

Why Anyware

* **An A+ Team:** Anyware is built by top talents. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award.
* **An A+ Robot:** Our robot, Pixmo, won the Best Innovation Award (top-1) at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026 — the two largest logistics automation exhibitions in the world. Pixmo also won the RBR50 Robotics Innovation Award.
* **Real Impact:** Your perception work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites, directly affects robot reliability and throughput, and must perform under real-world variation.
* **Fast Growth:** You will have strong ownership and real responsibility in a growing robotics company.
* **Generous Equity:** We offer generous equity in addition to salary and benefits.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is 150K-240K USD/year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable.

Benefits & Perks

* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid sick leave
* 401(k) plan support
* Daily meal credit

Equal Opportunity Statement

Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and any relevant materials through the **Anyware Career platform**. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team.

#### **Salary**

$150,000 - $240,000 per year

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control
* Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs
* Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations
* Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system
* Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports
* Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues

  
About the team  
The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in a relevant field
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience with circuit design and simulation
* Familiarity with superconducting qubit control and readout — pulse generation, multiplexed readout, feedback latency requirements
* Experience designing superconducting digital circuits (RSFQ/ERSFQ, adiabatic quantum phase parametron, or related single-flux-quantum logic families), including Josephson-junction circuit simulation and margin analysis
* Experience with EDA flows for custom circuit design — schematic capture, layout, physical verification, and working against a process design kit

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Knowledge of cryogenic electronics more broadly: cryo-CMOS, low-temperature amplifiers and mixers, thermal and power budgeting across refrigerator stages
* Experience with microwave engineering and signal integrity in dense cryogenic interconnect
* Experience taking chips through fabrication and correlating measured circuit behavior with design models
* Familiarity with quantum error correction decoding and the classical-processing requirements it places on control systems

In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.

As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.

Our commitment to solving the world’s toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as NVIDIA, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.

Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Software Engineer – Infrastructure & Platform Engineering to help build, maintain, and improve the infrastructure and tooling that support our products and engineering teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across Kubernetes, cloud and on-premises infrastructure, Linux, CI/CD, and automation. **What You'll Do**

* Build, maintain, and improve reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure across cloud, Kubernetes, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve build performance, test automation, and deployment reliability.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployments, monitoring, upgrades and operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
* Build and maintain systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, observability, security, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and platform issues, participate in incident response, and contribute to root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to identify technical challenges and deliver improvements to infrastructure and developer experience.

**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, software engineering, SRE, DevOps, or related fields.

* Solid understanding of Linux systems, including administration, troubleshooting, networking, and system performance.
* Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Go, Rust, or C++, with experience developing automation, tools, or services.
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and/or on-premises environments.
* Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, and configuration management tools such as Ansible or Chef.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools and reliability engineering practices.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues, implement solutions, and deliver assigned projects.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building internal developer platforms or developer productivity tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes in on-premises, private cloud, or bare-metal environments.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes operators, controllers, or Kubernetes-native tooling.
* Exposure to distributed technologies such as Cassandra, etcd, Ceph, Kafka, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

* Familiarity with infrastructure security, VPN, SSO, or network infrastructure.

* You independently deliver infrastructure improvements, automation, and tooling that make engineering teams more productive.

jobs.description:
### **Who we are**

Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road.

Every day, Gatik's autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high-frequency freight operations.

Gatik's momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business.

And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list.

There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here.

**About the Team**

Maps are a foundation of Gatik's autonomy stack, supporting localization, perception, prediction, planning, and simulation. The Map Infrastructure team builds the systems that turn fleet sensor data into accurate, versioned, validated maps and deliver them reliably to every truck and every simulation run. Because Gatik grows by launching new customer routes, how fast and safely we can map, validate, and deploy a new route directly shapes how fast the business scales.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer on Map Infrastructure, you'll design and build the pipelines, storage, services, and tools behind Gatik's maps, from raw sensor logs to the map data our trucks load on the road. You'll work closely with localization, autonomy, simulation, and operations teams to make map creation faster, map quality measurable, and map updates safe to ship.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build map creation pipelines.** Design and scale pipelines that process lidar, camera, and GNSS/IMU data from the fleet into high-definition maps, including alignment, semantic layer generation, and automated and human-in-the-loop labeling.
* **Speed up route onboarding.** Reduce the time and cost to map, validate, and deploy new customer routes and hubs through automation, better tooling, and clear process.
* **Own map storage and versioning.** Build the geospatial data platform that stores map data with versioning, provenance, and clear schemas and data contracts, so every truck and simulation run can trace exactly which map it used.
* **Deliver maps to the vehicle.** Build reliable, efficient services that package, compress, and distribute map updates to the fleet, with safe rollout, rollback, and compatibility guarantees for onboard software.
* **Detect and manage map change.** Build systems that use fleet data to detect real-world changes such as construction, lane changes, and new signage, and route them into fast, safe map updates.
* **Make map quality measurable.** Define and implement map quality metrics and automated validation checks for geometry, topology, semantics, and localization performance, and gate releases on them.
* **Build tools people love.** Develop map visualization, editing, review, and QA tools that make it fast for engineers and operators to inspect, correct, and approve map data.
* **Connect maps to simulation and ML.** Make map data easy to consume in simulation, scenario generation, and ML training pipelines, in partnership with the simulation and Scalable ML teams.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Champion clean interfaces, testing, code review, observability, and fast, dependable CI across map systems, and help root-cause and prevent map-related incidents.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Geomatics, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant industry experience (or a Master's degree and 3+ years).
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or C++, including designing modular, maintainable, well-tested systems in a shared codebase.
* Experience building large-scale data pipelines and distributed processing systems, using tools such as Spark, Ray, Beam, or similar, on cloud infrastructure.
* Experience working with geospatial data, including coordinate systems and projections, spatial indexing (such as S2 or H3), and geospatial databases or libraries (such as PostGIS, GDAL, or Shapely).
* Experience designing data storage, versioning, and serving systems with clear schemas and APIs (for example, Protobuf or similar).
* Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with autonomy, simulation, and operations teams.

We're headquartered in Santa Clara, California, but our impact is felt on the roads and in the supply chains that keep essential goods moving for some of the biggest companies in North America.

With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

**About Agility Robotics**
--------------------------

Agility Robotics builds Digit — the first humanoid robot doing real, paid work in warehouses and distribution centers today. Our mission is to build robot partners that augment the human workforce, and Digit is already working alongside people at real customer sites through our Agility Partner Program. Humanoid robotics is one of the most closely watched spaces in tech right now, and very few engineering teams get to write the software that commands and manages a fleet of humanoid robots operating in the real world.

**About the Team**
------------------

You'll join the Software Services (backend) team, part of the broader Applications & Platform Software Engineering organization building **Arc** — our cloud application for robot fleet management, robot operations, and fleet data collection. The team spans Senior Staff to SWE III, so you'll have direct access to experienced engineers as you ramp up: you'll get an assigned mentor for your first 90 days, and after that you'll work closely with whichever senior or staff engineer is leading your project.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build backend APIs and services for Arc, our cloud-based robot fleet management platform.
* Own well-scoped features end-to-end, and contribute to larger ones alongside senior engineers.
* Turn product requirements into technical designs — write design docs, build proof-of-concepts, and ship code.
* Help redesign our system and refactor services as we scale and evolve.
* Work cross-functionally with product, UX, front-end, robot hardware/software, customer solutions, and operations teams.
* Support what you build through its full lifecycle, including a flexible, team-designed on-call rotation (roughly once every 3-4 weeks).

**Technical Skills & Requirements**
-----------------------------------

### **Core Requirements**

* BS or MS in computer science or related field or equivalent industry experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in a software engineer role.
* Strong proficiency in Java and Python and Rust or Go. Our backend is mostly in Java and Python right now but we are looking at adopting Rust or Go.
* Experience developing backend cloud systems and associated concepts, frameworks and technologies - application frameworks (Spring Boot), databases (SQL and NoSQL), messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT), APIs (REST, gRPC) and data formats (Json, Protobuf).
* Experience with AWS - DynamoDB, RDS (Postgres), S3, SQS / SNS.
* Experience with SDLC processes, practices, workflows and tools - Github, CI/CD processes, Testing approaches (unit tests, end to end tests), deployments, feature flags, Docker, Kubernetes etc.
* Experience starting with feature requirements and working with them towards end-to-end solutions.
* Experience working in fast paced environments sometimes with changing priorities.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About the HR Product Team**
-----------------------------

The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.

We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi-product integration.

The team is composed of high-impact squads focused on four core domains:

* **Talent:** Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the design and implementation of core backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities and complex business logic.
* Ensure all systems are built for high-volume scale, reliability, and security, making strategic decisions about infrastructure and data integrity.
* Work seamlessly with product, frontend, and platform teams to translate feature goals into robust, high-performance technical solutions.
* Elevate the team's technical standards, lead code and design reviews, and mentor engineers on backend best practices.

* Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases.
* You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale.
* Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery.
* Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We’re AV Frameworks within AV Platform Core at General Motors. We build the foundational frameworks that power robotics and autonomous capabilities across distributed compute — with a focus on inter-process communication (IPC), middleware, and developer experience that make complex systems reliable, observable, and fast. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver the core communication and runtime building blocks used by AV/Robotics applications on vehicles, on benches, and in simulation. You’ll work across C++ systems, Linux, and networking/IPC to achieve low-latency messaging, deterministic scheduling, and production-grade reliability at scale.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Own design and implementation of high-performance IPC and middleware primitives (publish/subscribe, shared memory, serialization, discovery, QoS).

* Drive latency, throughput, and determinism improvements through profiling, tracing, benchmarking, and targeted optimizations.

* Build developer-facing APIs, tooling, and documentation that improve ergonomics, correctness, and velocity for internal customers.

* Deliver platform-ready components with observability (metrics, logs, traces), robust fault handling, and reproducible performance characteristics.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with platform OS, drivers, safety, controls, perception, and tooling teams to integrate end-to-end solutions.

* Apply production rigor: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, soak), performance and regression gates, and rollout/rollback discipline.

Mentor engineers, contribute to design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering excellence.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years building systems-level software in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) or Rust on Linux.

* Deep knowledge of concurrency, memory management, lock-free or low-contention patterns, and performance profiling.

* Hands-on experience with IPC/messaging systems and distributed systems fundamentals (serialization, backpressure, flow control, QoS).

* Strong understanding of networking (sockets, TCP/UDP, multicast, NICs, buffers, MTU, packetization) and time synchronization concepts.

Proficiency with build and CI tooling (Bazel/Buck/CMake, test frameworks, artifact/versioning strategies).  

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Robotics/AV middleware: ROS 2, DDS, gRPC, ZeroMQ, eCAL, shared memory IPC.

* Serialization and data: Protobuf, FlatBuffers, Cap’n Proto, zero-copy techniques, record/resimulation pipelines.

* Advanced networking/IO: io\_uring, RDMA/PCIe messaging, kernel/bpf-based observability, packet capture and analysis.

* Real-time Linux and systems constraints (scheduling, CPU isolation, priority inversion mitigation, bounded latency).

* Tracing and performance tooling: perf, LTTng, eBPF, flamegraphs; defining and enforcing performance SLOs.

* Safety and reliability awareness (diagnostics, failover, degraded modes, basics of ISO 26262 considerations for software components).

Secondary languages and tooling: Python/Go for tooling/integration

**About Sycamore**
==================

Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need.

We are a small, engineering-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders.

**The role**
============

You own the business result of a customer engagement from the first conversation with the customer through to the expansion that follows. Our Applied AI engineers own the technical result: the workflow runs, the agent behaves, the integration holds under production load. You own everything around it. The engagement lands in scope and on the date, the value it created is measured in numbers the customer already trusts, and their leadership knows what to build next.

You work as a pair with the engineer on every deployment, and with the account executive on everything above it. You program manage the work day to day, you build the map of the customer’s organization, and you are the person who says a use case is too large for a first release or that a go-live date does not survive the resourcing behind it. That is unpopular work, and it is most of what protects a deployment. You do not carry a quota. You are expected to know the heartbeat of the account better than anyone else at Sycamore.

**Why this role exists**
========================

A pilot that works technically and then dies quietly is the most common failure in enterprise AI. The agent runs, the demo goes well, and nine months later nobody can say what changed in the operating numbers, so the renewal conversation restarts from zero.

Our engineers deploy fast, and that speed creates a second job. Someone has to agree what success means before the build starts, keep the first release small enough to reach production, measure the result the way the customer’s own finance and operations teams measure things, and turn one working workflow into the next five. ====================

* Program manage pilots and full implementations end to end: scope, resourcing, dependencies, milestones, go-live dates, and the weekly rhythm that keeps all of it honest.
* Agree the business case before the build starts. Set the baseline, the metric, and the measurement method with the customer in writing, while there is still time to instrument it.

* Bring a point of view to roadmap conversations. When the same need shows up across three accounts, make the case that it belongs in the product roadmap.
* Hand expansion to the account executive with the evidence already assembled, and stay in the room for that conversation.
* Feed the field back into product: which use cases repeat across customers, where measurement is hard, and what keeps deployments from reaching production.

**What this role is not**
=========================

* It is not a customer success role that begins at go-live and reports on adoption.
* It is not project management without a point of view on what should be built.
* It is not a quota-carrying sales role. You do not own the number, though you own most of what makes the number possible.

* Evidence you have carried complex enterprise implementations all the way to production, with real dates, real dependencies, and real internal resistance.

**Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows.  
  
The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, cross-team collaboration, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.

* **Enable self-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Love using AI to solve big, messy problems that actually move a business? Join Sales AI as an Applied Scientist and own the science behind how Amazon Ads helps every advertiser grow, from understanding where each brand is on its growth journey to building the GenAI agents account teams use every day.  
  
Advertising is one of the fastest growing parts of our business, and science sits at the heart of how we help brands succeed. Our scientists work on two connected problems. The first is figuring out, for each brand, the smartest next step it can take to grow, and turning that into a clear, personalized recommendation. The second is building LLM-powered assistants and agents that put that intelligence into the hands of the people who work with those brands, accurately and at scale. If you want real ownership, hard problems, and models that ship, we'd love to talk.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll own production science systems that account teams rely on every day. For example, you might build the recommendation engine that maps where each advertiser is in their growth journey and what their best next step is, or improve the accuracy of the LLM-powered assistants and agents that account teams use to prepare for and run customer conversations. Day to day that means:  
  

* Turn ambiguous business problems into well-defined science problems, and choose the right approach to solve them
* Build, ship, and continuously improve models in production, and own their quality once they launch
* Measure whether our models really move the business, through A/B tests, causal analysis, and offline evaluation
* Partner with engineers and product managers to take ideas from early research into production
* Set the technical direction for your area, raise the scientific bar, and mentor other scientists
* Explain complex methods and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners, and sales leaders

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might start by testing a new modeling approach, then review evaluation results with engineers to decide whether a model is ready to launch. Later you could meet with product partners to agree on what to build next, or dig into data to understand why a recommendation isn't landing. Your customers are the account teams who work directly with brands, and the brands themselves, who rely on your work to decide where to invest and how to grow.  
  
About the team  
Sales AI is a central science and data engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales. Our mission is to power selling motions and account team workflows with state-of-the-art AI and ML services. We build advertiser insights, recommendations, and generative AI-powered applications woven throughout account team workflows. * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Dirac is building the creative suite for manufacturing engineering. Manufacturing engineering has been underserved by fractured tooling. The work of defining how a product gets built is spread across process plans, MBOMs, routings, work instructions, spreadsheets, PLM configurations, ERP tables, and internal tools. Each artifact represents only part of the process, forcing engineers to rebuild context whenever a design changes.

BuildOS brings these workflows together in one environment. Manufacturing engineers author, version, review, and distribute the Build—the canonical definition of how a product is produced.

**About the Role**

Our customers build aircraft, spacecraft, defense systems, ships, energy equipment, and heavy machinery. You'll own features end to end, from the services underneath to the tools manufacturing engineers use every day. The work spans backend, frontend, and 3D, and most of it starts with a real customer problem.

We want engineers who take a problem from vague to shipped, find the root cause before the fix, and use AI tools well while owning the result.

**What You'll Work On**

Depending on your strengths, you might work on:

* Turning CAD models into structured, versioned manufacturing data
* An authoring experience manufacturing engineers live in all day
* Interactive 3D in the browser for assemblies with thousands of parts
* AI that drafts work instructions and helps engineers plan a build
* Integrations with the enterprise systems manufacturers already run
* Secure deployments for aerospace and defense customers

**Our Stack**

Go, TypeScript and React, Rust and WebAssembly, Python and C++, on AWS and Azure. You don't need experience with all of it.

**Requirements**

* Strong in Go or TypeScript, and willing to work in the other; able to read Rust, Python, or C++ when a bug leads there
* Experience building backend services with typed APIs (protobuf/gRPC or similar) on top of a relational database
* Experience building non-trivial React frontends with real state management
* You debug from evidence: logs, a reproduction, and the root cause before the fix
* You check your own work in the running app, not just in passing tests
* You use AI coding agents every day and review their output as hard as a colleague's
* Clear, concise writing in design notes, PR descriptions, and tickets
* You've built something, at work or not, and can explain it in conversation

**Nice to Have**

* CAD, 3D graphics, or computational geometry
* Rust, WebAssembly, or GPU programming
* Integrations with enterprise systems such as PLM, ERP, or MES
* Shipping LLM-based features to production
* Cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes
* Security or compliance work in regulated industries
* A background in manufacturing, aerospace, or defense

**How We Work**

* **Own it end to end.** You take work from the first customer conversation to proof that it works in the product.
* **Learn the user.** You'll work with the manufacturing engineers who use what you build, and sometimes spend time on their factory floors.
* **High trust, high agency.** If something needs doing, you do it.
* **AI-native.** We build with AI tools every day and hold their output to the same bar as our own.
* **Fix it once.** When we catch a mistake, we fix it and make sure it can't happen again.

**Compensation**

Base: $120,000 - $200,000 + Equity

**Location**

Fully in person at our NYC office in the Empire State Building (350 5th Ave). Relocation assistance is available.

New York Pay Range

$120,000 - $200,000 USD

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Dirac is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Dirac is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

**Eligibility**

Employment is restricted to **U.S. Persons** as defined by **ITAR (22 CFR § 120.62)**

**Benefits:**

* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure you and your family stay healthy.
* Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy flexible, high-trust PTO and sick leave.
* Stock Options: Participate in our success with a generous stock option plan.
* Commuter Benefits (NYC): Save on transportation costs with our commuter benefits program.

We're looking for a hands-on Embedded Software Engineer with extensive experience developing software (C/C++) in a Linux environment. You will be responsible for working with a team of engineers in the development and implementation of a wide range of low-level embedded software, hardware development, and the development of application software running on the Wave Relay® network. * Using C/C++ to architect, develop, and implement software for embedded Linux hardware platforms
* Supporting hardware development
* Supporting production hardware test systems running cross-platform applications built with Java for Windows and Linux
* Developing application software running on the Wave Relay® network, which may include device drivers, Linux kernel modules, network stack development, porting existing software to new embedded platforms, and other low-level programming activities
* Supporting internal and external engineering activities, including travel to test locations, military facilities, and customer sites to directly support the testing, evaluation, and deployment of the Wave Relay® system
* Integrating other systems, sensors, and components with the Wave Relay® system
* Writing technical proposals

Job Qualifications & Experience :

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience
* At least 3 years of work experience developing software for embedded Linux systems in C/C++
* At least 1 year of work experience with Java
* Must have a US Security Clearance or the ability to obtain one

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in computer science/electrical engineering/computer engineering or a related field

* Experience with UNIX shell scripting

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires scalable model training and simulation, efficient distributed computing, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers, scientists, and shared-platform teams to turn complex modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer focused on ML infrastructure. You’ll build the frameworks, distributed execution capabilities, and developer tooling that help scientists develop, train, evaluate, and productionize models. Your work will make it easier to move from an experimental model to a dependable production workflow and to run the simulations and backtests needed to evaluate marketplace decisions.  
  
How do we scale training and simulation across CPUs and GPUs? How do we make experiments reproducible and performance bottlenecks easy to diagnose? How do we support new modeling approaches without creating a separate infrastructure stack for every use case? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, close collaboration with modeling teams, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build shared ML frameworks:** Design and evolve reusable interfaces and libraries for model development, training, inference, evaluation, and backtesting.
* **Scale distributed workloads:** Build and optimize execution capabilities for training, simulation, and optimization across CPU and GPU infrastructure.
* **Accelerate experimentation:** Develop tooling for hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and performance analysis so scientists can evaluate ideas faster.
* **Simplify productionization:** Create reliable orchestration, configuration, dependency management, and deployment patterns that reduce the gap between experimentation and production.
* **Improve performance and efficiency:** Profile workloads, diagnose compute and memory bottlenecks, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across runtime, resource utilization, reliability, and cost.
* **Build on shared platforms:** Partner with Uber’s ML and compute platform teams to adopt and extend common capabilities rather than maintain isolated infrastructure.
* **Own systems and raise the engineering bar:** Lead projects from design through rollout and operations, participate in on-call and incident response, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including work on ML infrastructure, distributed computing, or production platforms for computationally intensive workloads.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience building maintainable, well-tested software.
* Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems or workflow execution infrastructure.
* Experience supporting production ML workflows, such as model training, batch inference, evaluation, or deployment.
* Understanding of performance fundamentals, including parallelism, memory management, data movement, and resource utilization.
* Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations.
* Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering, data science, and platform teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with Ray or comparable distributed computing frameworks.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or LightGBM.
* Experience with distributed training, GPU performance profiling, or CPU/GPU workload optimization.
* Experience building hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, or model evaluation infrastructure.
* Experience supporting large-scale simulation, backtesting, forecasting, or optimization workloads.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration, containerized execution, CI/CD, and build or dependency-management systems.
* Experience designing shared frameworks or developer platforms adopted by multiple modeling teams.
* A track record of measurable improvements in training or inference performance, infrastructure reliability, compute efficiency, or model-development productivity.
