jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
=======================

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

**Role Description**
====================

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll lead the design, delivery, and ongoing optimization of automation solutions for Tennr’s most complex customers — large-scale health systems, national provider groups, and enterprise partners. This is a highly technical, strategic, and customer-facing role that demands deep domain fluency, executive presence, and strong systems thinking.

You’ll own implementations end-to-end: from pre-sale discovery and business case alignment to go-live and expansion. You’ll act as both a trusted technical advisor and a project lead, working closely with senior customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams at Tennr to ensure lasting success.

This role sits within a high-performance implementation pod and directly influences Tennr’s go-to-market and product strategy.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead end-to-end implementations, from discovery to post-go-live
* Align cross-functional teams and manage project delivery, risks, and change
* Conduct operational audits to identify workflow gaps and automation opportunities
* Design scalable, configurable solutions using Tennr’s platform and APIs
* Reimagine processes with automation best practices, not just replicate legacy systems
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Sales to shape solutions and delivery scope
* Maintain documentation, enable knowledge transfer, and improve internal delivery tools
* Support sales strategy, mentor junior team members, and influence product roadmap

**Qualifications**
==================

* 3+ years of experience in SaaS delivery or solution design
* A degree or minor in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of APIs, systems integration, and technical architecture
* Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements with large enterprise customers
* Skilled at communicating technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences
* Experience navigating complex org structures and aligning cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on strategic, scalable solutions
* Business acumen and domain fluency — ideally in healthcare or similarly complex industries
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced, unstructured environments
* Demonstrated ability to mentor others and contribute to team-wide best practices
* High ownership mindset and urgency — proactive, resourceful, and impact-driven

Nice to Haves

* Familiarity with workflow automation, RPA, or enterprise integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato)
* Background in consulting, solution architecture, or technical customer success
* Experience in startup environments or scaling delivery functions

**Why Tennr?**
==============

* Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
* Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure
* Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
* Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week
* Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

**Benefits**
============

* Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street
* Unlimited PTO
* 100% paid employee health benefit options
* Employer funded 401(k) match
* Competitive parental leave

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

### **About Zipline**

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

* Extend Zipline's internal AI analytics harness: add evaluation tests, ground-truth datasets, and conservative fallback behaviors to ensure AI answers used in ops are explainable and auditable.
* Mentor and elevate the team: set standards for testing, dbt CI/CD, production monitoring, and runbooks; onboard and review work from junior analytics engineers.

---------------------

* Direct experience operating production systems under failure: you have seen systems break, led incident response, and implemented durable fixes and prevention measures.

**Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires scalable model training and simulation, efficient distributed computing, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers, scientists, and shared-platform teams to turn complex modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer focused on ML infrastructure. You’ll build the frameworks, distributed execution capabilities, and developer tooling that help scientists develop, train, evaluate, and productionize models. Your work will make it easier to move from an experimental model to a dependable production workflow and to run the simulations and backtests needed to evaluate marketplace decisions.  
  
How do we scale training and simulation across CPUs and GPUs? How do we make experiments reproducible and performance bottlenecks easy to diagnose? How do we support new modeling approaches without creating a separate infrastructure stack for every use case? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, close collaboration with modeling teams, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build shared ML frameworks:** Design and evolve reusable interfaces and libraries for model development, training, inference, evaluation, and backtesting.
* **Scale distributed workloads:** Build and optimize execution capabilities for training, simulation, and optimization across CPU and GPU infrastructure.
* **Accelerate experimentation:** Develop tooling for hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and performance analysis so scientists can evaluate ideas faster.
* **Simplify productionization:** Create reliable orchestration, configuration, dependency management, and deployment patterns that reduce the gap between experimentation and production.
* **Improve performance and efficiency:** Profile workloads, diagnose compute and memory bottlenecks, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across runtime, resource utilization, reliability, and cost.
* **Build on shared platforms:** Partner with Uber’s ML and compute platform teams to adopt and extend common capabilities rather than maintain isolated infrastructure.
* **Own systems and raise the engineering bar:** Lead projects from design through rollout and operations, participate in on-call and incident response, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including work on ML infrastructure, distributed computing, or production platforms for computationally intensive workloads.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience building maintainable, well-tested software.
* Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems or workflow execution infrastructure.
* Experience supporting production ML workflows, such as model training, batch inference, evaluation, or deployment.
* Understanding of performance fundamentals, including parallelism, memory management, data movement, and resource utilization.
* Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations.
* Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering, data science, and platform teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with Ray or comparable distributed computing frameworks.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or LightGBM.
* Experience with distributed training, GPU performance profiling, or CPU/GPU workload optimization.
* Experience building hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, or model evaluation infrastructure.
* Experience supporting large-scale simulation, backtesting, forecasting, or optimization workloads.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration, containerized execution, CI/CD, and build or dependency-management systems.
* Experience designing shared frameworks or developer platforms adopted by multiple modeling teams.
* A track record of measurable improvements in training or inference performance, infrastructure reliability, compute efficiency, or model-development productivity.

new_jobs.description:
**About Sycamore**
==================

Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need.

We are a small, engineering-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders.

**The role**
============

You own the business result of a customer engagement from the first conversation with the customer through to the expansion that follows. Our Applied AI engineers own the technical result: the workflow runs, the agent behaves, the integration holds under production load. You own everything around it. The engagement lands in scope and on the date, the value it created is measured in numbers the customer already trusts, and their leadership knows what to build next.

You work as a pair with the engineer on every deployment, and with the account executive on everything above it. You program manage the work day to day, you build the map of the customer’s organization, and you are the person who says a use case is too large for a first release or that a go-live date does not survive the resourcing behind it. That is unpopular work, and it is most of what protects a deployment. You do not carry a quota. You are expected to know the heartbeat of the account better than anyone else at Sycamore.

**Why this role exists**
========================

A pilot that works technically and then dies quietly is the most common failure in enterprise AI. The agent runs, the demo goes well, and nine months later nobody can say what changed in the operating numbers, so the renewal conversation restarts from zero.

Our engineers deploy fast, and that speed creates a second job. Someone has to agree what success means before the build starts, keep the first release small enough to reach production, measure the result the way the customer’s own finance and operations teams measure things, and turn one working workflow into the next five. That is this role.

**What you will do**
====================

* Work the opportunity with the account executive before it closes: discovery, process walkthroughs, and a first release you would be willing to put your own name on.
* Write the success criteria into the agreement: what gets measured, against what baseline, by when, and who on the customer’s side signs that it happened.
* Program manage pilots and full implementations end to end: scope, resourcing, dependencies, milestones, go-live dates, and the weekly rhythm that keeps all of it honest.
* Agree the business case before the build starts. Set the baseline, the metric, and the measurement method with the customer in writing, while there is still time to instrument it.
* Measure and publish the outcome in the customer’s own terms: hours returned, cycle time, exception rates, cost per case, whatever their operating reviews already track.
* Hold scope against pressure from both sides, and protect the engineer’s ability to ship something that works.
* Build and maintain the account map with the account executive: processes, owners, budget holders, adjacent teams, and the politics between them.
* Produce the ranked list of use cases and product capabilities the customer should take on next, each one sized, sponsored, and tied to a business owner.
* Make the call on what should not be automated at all, and be able to defend it to the customer’s sponsor and to our engineers.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap conversations. When the same need shows up across three accounts, make the case that it belongs in the product roadmap.
* Hand expansion to the account executive with the evidence already assembled, and stay in the room for that conversation.
* Feed the field back into product: which use cases repeat across customers, where measurement is hard, and what keeps deployments from reaching production.

**What this role is not**
=========================

* It is not a customer success role that begins at go-live and reports on adoption.
* It is not project management without a point of view on what should be built.
* It is not a quota-carrying sales role. You do not own the number, though you own most of what makes the number possible.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 6+ years in enterprise program delivery, consulting, value engineering, customer success leadership, or a deployment role at an enterprise software company. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction.
* Evidence you have carried complex enterprise implementations all the way to production, with real dates, real dependencies, and real internal resistance.
* You have been in the room before a deal closed and shaped what got signed, not only what got built.
* Product judgment. You can take a messy operational process and decide what an agent should own, what it should hand back, and what should stay human, then hold that line under pressure from both the customer and our own engineers.
* The ability to build a value case an enterprise finance team will accept: a defensible baseline, an honest attribution argument, and numbers the customer can reproduce from their own systems.
* Operational literacy. You can sit with a head of shared services or an operations lead, follow the process they describe, and find the steps where the cost actually sits.
* The willingness to be the person who says no to scope, and the judgment to know when saying yes is the right call.
* Enough technical depth to be useful next to an engineer. You understand what an agent can and cannot do, what an integration costs, and why a permission model matters.
* Executive presence. You can brief a COO on outcomes in the morning and spend the afternoon in a process walkthrough with the team that does the work.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Fullstack, Spend Controls
new_jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Great spend controls help businesses move quickly without losing control of their money. Ramp’s Spend Controls team builds the core capabilities behind Ramp’s most critical primitives, like budgets and cards,helping customers put spending policies into practice and understand how their money is being deployed.

We’re looking for a fullstack engineer to build and improve these experiences, from the interfaces admins use to configure controls to the backend logic that makes them work reliably. You’ll build and own new features end to end, simplify complex spending workflows, and improve the quality of products customers depend on every day.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build fullstack features to improve how customers manage the lifecycle of issued money, with clearer behavior and sensible defaults
* Work with product, design, and engineering partners to turn customer needs into well-scoped features and deliver them from technical design through launch and iteration
* Build better visibility into spend and utilization, including configurable restrictions and sensible buffers, so that users can spend money easily, while transactions that shouldn’t happen are declined properly
* Contribute to on-call support, investigate production issues, and address recurring problems through testing and targeted quality improvements

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------

* Experience building and shipping production features across frontend interfaces and backend services
* The ability to own a feature end to end, break down the work, design key components, and follow through on delivery
* Sound judgment about data correctness, reliability, and keeping complex product behavior understandable
* A customer-focused approach to building software, with attention to usability and practical tradeoffs
* Experience testing and debugging software, including investigating issues in production
* Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with product, design, and engineering teammates

**Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend Full Stack - HR Product
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the HR Product Team**
-----------------------------

The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.

We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi-product integration.

### **What We Build**

The team is composed of high-impact squads focused on four core domains:

* **HRIS (Human Resources Information System):** Building the core employee record, organizational structure, and workflows that serve as the single source of truth for all other Rippling products.
* **Time:** Developing accurate, scalable, and globally compliant Time & Attendance systems, including clocking, time-off accrual, and scheduling, ensuring employees are paid correctly and legally.
* **Benefits:** Creating and maintaining the marketplace and administration tools for health, retirement, and other employee benefits, handling complex enrollment, eligibility, and provider integrations.
* **Talent:** Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Develop and improve both product backend capabilities and user-facing features, working across the stack to make them shine
* Collaborate closely with PMs and designers to translate complex product requirements and visual designs into responsive, high-quality code.
* Move quickly and confidently, making smart decisions to fill in the gaps where product details aren’t fully defined—always learning from user feedback.
* Play an active role in building a culture of excellence within our product and engineering teams.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Django, or related technologies.
* Familiarity in frontend development with React or typescript.
* Exposure and hands on experience with systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale
* Strong product intuition: you care about design and user experience and are quick to identify how these could be improved.
* Experience shipping complex projects
* Deep understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals
* Strong communication skills with a variety of stakeholders

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
180,000 - 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1)

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales)
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**
=======================

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

**Role Description**
====================

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll lead the design, delivery, and ongoing optimization of automation solutions for Tennr’s most complex customers — large-scale health systems, national provider groups, and enterprise partners. This is a highly technical, strategic, and customer-facing role that demands deep domain fluency, executive presence, and strong systems thinking.

You’ll own implementations end-to-end: from pre-sale discovery and business case alignment to go-live and expansion. You’ll act as both a trusted technical advisor and a project lead, working closely with senior customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams at Tennr to ensure lasting success.

This role sits within a high-performance implementation pod and directly influences Tennr’s go-to-market and product strategy.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead end-to-end implementations, from discovery to post-go-live
* Align cross-functional teams and manage project delivery, risks, and change
* Conduct operational audits to identify workflow gaps and automation opportunities
* Design scalable, configurable solutions using Tennr’s platform and APIs
* Reimagine processes with automation best practices, not just replicate legacy systems
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Sales to shape solutions and delivery scope
* Maintain documentation, enable knowledge transfer, and improve internal delivery tools
* Support sales strategy, mentor junior team members, and influence product roadmap

**Qualifications**
==================

* 3+ years of experience in SaaS delivery or solution design
* A degree or minor in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of APIs, systems integration, and technical architecture
* Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements with large enterprise customers
* Skilled at communicating technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences
* Experience navigating complex org structures and aligning cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on strategic, scalable solutions
* Business acumen and domain fluency — ideally in healthcare or similarly complex industries
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced, unstructured environments
* Demonstrated ability to mentor others and contribute to team-wide best practices
* High ownership mindset and urgency — proactive, resourceful, and impact-driven

Nice to Haves

* Familiarity with workflow automation, RPA, or enterprise integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato)
* Background in consulting, solution architecture, or technical customer success
* Experience in startup environments or scaling delivery functions

**Why Tennr?**
==============

* Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
* Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure
* Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
* Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week
* Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

**Benefits**
============

* Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street
* Unlimited PTO
* 100% paid employee health benefit options
* Employer funded 401(k) match
* Competitive parental leave

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K
